answer: Per +1 year of age, the change in log-odds of remission is −0.0795 (SE 0.026; 95% Wald CI −0.131 to −0.028; p = 0.0025), from a logistic regression of remission (Efficacy = PR vs SD+PD) on Age, BMI, and Gender (Male=1, Female reference), n=80, convergence confirmed. This corresponds to an odds ratio of 0.924 (≈7.6% lower odds of remission per year of age).
